summary:
Frontend-only RETEST after fixes for the two follow-ups from iteration_111: (1) KycGraceBanner rendering immediately on in-app CompanySelector switch WITHOUT a page reload, and (2) the mobile full-screen UpgradeToBusinessModal end-to-end flow. Fresh fixture confirmed: KYC Test (Individual) is now company_id=112 (individual, over $10k volume, not KYC-approved).

RESULTS (all PASS):

PRIMARY RETEST — grace banner on in-app switch (desktop 1920x1080):
- Logged in via 2-step (email + Continue + password + Sign in) -> /dashboard OK.
- Opened company-selector-trigger and selected company-option-1 (The Dev Store, business+approved) FIRST. After 4s wait: data-testid=kyc-grace-banner count = 0 (correctly HIDDEN). URL unchanged (/dashboard, no reload).
- Without reloading, opened switcher again and selected company-option-112 (KYC Test Individual). Banner data-testid=kyc-grace-banner appeared within ~2.0s. data-testid=kyc-grace-days text = '90 days to verify your identity'. data-testid=kyc-grace-start-btn present (NOT clicked per instructions). URL remained /dashboard (no manual reload). Two GET /api/kyc/status?company_id=112 -> 200 fired after the switch. This confirms the SWR-key-collision fix in KycGraceBanner (['kyc/status/full', companyId]) resolves iteration_111's MEDIUM bug.

MOBILE FULL-SCREEN MODAL (viewport 390x844):
- Fresh mobile login, dashboard loaded on 112.
- Opened company-selector-trigger; company-upgrade-112 chip visible; company-type-112 = 'INDIVIDUAL'.
- Clicked company-upgrade-112 -> data-testid=upgrade-business-modal opened.
- FULL-SCREEN sheet confirmed: modal bounding box = {x:0, y:0, width:390, height:844}, exactly covers viewport. No overflow/clipping observed. data-testid=upgrade-business-cancel-btn visible and tappable (38x38 hit area).
- Fields verified: upgrade-business-name-input prefilled 'KYC Test (Individual)'; upgrade-business-country-input Autocomplete accepted typed 'United Sta' and rendered upgrade-country-option-US; upgrade-business-website-input filled with https://mobile-retest.example.com; upgrade-business-vat-input left blank; upgrade-business-submit-btn enabled.
- Submitted -> PUT /api/company/upgrade-to-business/112 -> 200. data-testid=upgrade-business-success rendered "You're now a Business account" and the modal auto-closed.
- Post-upgrade: re-opened switcher on mobile; company-upgrade-112 chip GONE (count=0) and data-testid=company-type-112 now reads 'BUSINESS'. 

CONSOLE — React 'key prop spread into JSX' warning:
- Zero occurrences of the 'A props object containing a `key` prop is being spread into JSX' warning during the country dropdown open+type/select flow (or anywhere else in these runs). Iteration_111's dev-only warning is resolved by the renderOption destructuring fix in UpgradeToBusinessModal.

Sanity checks:
- Did not click Start verification (external Veriff) per instructions.
- No page.reload() was ever invoked; URL stayed on /dashboard throughout both scenarios.
critical_code_review_comments: Both regressions from iteration_111 are cleanly fixed. The distinct SWR key ['kyc/status/full', companyId] in KycGraceBanner is a good, minimal fix — no coupling to KycVerifiedBadge's cache. Consider a shared hook (e.g., useKycStatus(companyId)) that internally decides which fields it needs, to prevent future accidental key collisions between banner/badge components fetching overlapping data.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (2/2 retest scenarios PASS + console warning resolved)

seed_data_creation: Executed the intended upgrade of company_id=112 from individual -> business as part of the mobile flow (PUT /api/company/upgrade-to-business/112 -> 200). Company 112 is now account_type=business. Any future retest of the individual->business path needs a fresh individual fixture or DB revert of tbl_company.company_id=112.account_type back to 'individual' (and clear country/website that we set).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The two follow-ups from iteration_111 are resolved: (1) grace banner renders in ~2s after CompanySelector switch on /dashboard with no reload; (2) mobile full-screen upgrade modal works end-to-end and the country Autocomplete no longer emits the React key-prop-spread warning. After this run, company_id=112 is BUSINESS. For any next individual->business retest, ask backend to revert 112 or provide a new individual fixture.
